parameters.content:
# Turn a trends report into topic items

This manual demo uses fictional, timestamped data. Click Execute workflow to see two topic items. It makes no network requests and starts no Actor. Keep the demo label attached to these rows.

For real topics, use your own account at https://apify.com/automatron/google-trends-now-feed with input:
```json
{"country":"US","maxItems":20}
```
Read the completed run's REPORT, or its single dataset report row. Replace the fictional report node with that report. Keep the Split Out node on trends; each output has topic, country and observedAt. Test manually before considering recurrence.

Price and limitations: $0.01 per completed nonempty live country feed, up to 20 topics. US, GB, BE, DE, FR only. Current RSS topics; no keyword history, exact volume or predictions. Separate n8n hosting and Apify post-run reads/storage costs may apply. This demonstration causes no Apify event charge.

Bookmark the Actor if useful for later. After actual use, an honest review of what worked and what needs improvement is welcome. No incentive or star score is requested.

AI disclosure: prepared with AI assistance and checked against the Actor contract.
